messages:
Nora (CS): Paragon sent back the vendor questionnaire but left the DPA unsigned and didn't attach SOC2 evidence. They said 'customer-managed keys' but no vendor listed.

Liam S: Quick scan 7: missing signed DPA, SOC2 AOC/report (last 12 months), named KMS/HSM vendor, and a basic data flow diagram for PII.

Nora (CS): Drafting a request. Any wording Legal prefers? @Legal

Legal: Default to Redwood DPA v3. If they attach redlines, upload to /legal/review and include a one-paragraph business impact note.

Nora (CS): Draft to customer:
> Hi Paragon team, thanks for the questionnaire. Could you please attach the signed Redwood DPA (v3) and either a SOC2 AOC or SOC2 report covering the last 12 months? Please confirm the KMS/HSM vendor for customer-managed keys (e.g., AWS KMS, Azure Key Vault, HashiCorp Vault) and share a simple data flow diagram showing PII paths. We can provide an SFTP link for sensitive docs.

Liam S: Add this checklist to the intake record:
- Signed DPA (Redwood DPA v3)
- SOC2 AOC/report (last 12 months)
- Named KMS/HSM vendor + rotation cadence
- Data flow diagram (PII handling)
- Retention policy excerpt for embeddings/logs

SecOpsBot: Reminder: Vendor intake "Paragon" has 4 outstanding evidence items. Assigned to Nora (CS). Deadline: 2025-05-12.

Nora (CS): Message sent, SFTP link provided. Upload path: /shared/customer-evidence/Paragon.

Paragon (reply): We uploaded SOC2 Type 1 (2024) and use HashiCorp Vault for keys. We can provide a diagram. DPA unsigned  request to soften the data retention clause (reduce 60d to 30d).

Legal: SOC2 Type 1 acceptable only with compensating operational controls; request SecOps to run a focused review. DPA retention change is a material redline, escalate if they insist.

Liam S: Noted. I'll tag SecOps for the targeted review and prepare a short risk note for escalation.

AM-Raj: Renewal check in 7 weeks. If DPA unresolved mark renewal risk in Gainsight as "evidence outstanding - legal review" and alert me.

SecOpsBot: Evidence upload detected: /shared/customer-evidence/Paragon/soc2_2024_type1.pdf

Nora (CS): Uploaded SOC2 and initial diagram. Routing to SecOps and Legal with the customer's redline. Will update Gainsight once Legal confirms next steps. :thumbsup:
